sections.overview: Synodontis grandiops is a Tanganyika catfish described in 2006, but a 2024 revision treats it as a synonym of S. multipunctatus.
sections.identification: The original description emphasized its relatively large eye and spotted body; FishBase retains it as a separate species account.
sections.habitat: The original species account places it in Lake Tanganyika, over littoral-to-bottom shell, sand and mud habitats.
sections.diet: Its diet is poorly documented; the original account suggested small snails based on other Tanganyika Synodontis.
sections.behavior: Detailed behavior and reproduction are not established in the cited species account.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted do not provide species-specific reproductive observations under this name.
sections.ecology: The 2024 revision recognizes S. petricola as a distinct Tanganyika species; it also found broad overlap between S. grandiops and S. multipunctatus, leading to synonymy.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists the separate-name account as Not Evaluated; that entry predates the 2024 synonymy and is not a status assessment for S. multipunctatus.
